scripts.dev: node ./scripts/prebuild-if-native-changed.mjs && bun run verify:native-ai && EXPO_UNSTABLE_MCP_SERVER=1 bun expo run:ios
scripts.build:dev: bun run verify:native-ai && bunx eas-cli build --profile development --platform all
scripts.build:dev:ios: bun run verify:native-ai && bunx eas-cli build --profile development --platform ios
scripts.build:dev:android: bun run verify:native-ai && bunx eas-cli build --profile development --platform android
scripts.build:preview: bun run verify:native-ai && bunx eas-cli build --profile preview --platform all
scripts.build:preview:ios: bun run verify:native-ai && bunx eas-cli build --profile preview --platform ios
scripts.build:preview:android: bun run verify:native-ai && bunx eas-cli build --profile preview --platform android
scripts.build:prod: bun run verify:native-ai && bunx eas-cli build --profile production --platform all
scripts.build:prod:ios: bun run verify:native-ai && bunx eas-cli build --profile production --platform ios
scripts.build:prod:android: bun run verify:native-ai && bunx eas-cli build --profile production --platform android
scripts.build:local:ios: bun run verify:native-ai && bunx eas-cli build --profile production --platform ios --local --output ./sirius-prod.ipa
scripts.build:local:dev:ios: bun run verify:native-ai && bunx eas-cli build --profile development --platform ios --local --output ./sirius-dev.tar.gz
